title: Demand Finance Manager
description:
Job Description
Resumo da Posição
O Demand Finance Manager atuará como elo estratégico entre as áreas de Vendas, Marketing e Finanças, suportando a tomada de decisão através de análises financeiras, gestão de budget, acompanhamento de projetos de inovação e otimização de processos. Será responsável por garantir o alinhamento dos objetivos financeiros com as estratégias de negócio, promovendo eficiência e crescimento sustentável.

What are we looking for?

  • Formação superior em Administração, Economia, Contabilidade, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência prévia em Finanças, preferencialmente como Business Partner de Vendas/Marketing.
  • Conhecimento avançado em Excel e ferramentas de análise financeira.
  • Habilidade de comunicação, negociação e influência.
  • Perfil analítico, proativo e orientado a resultados.
  • Inglês avançado.

What will be your key responsibilities?

  • Processos de Inovação:
  • Suportar financeiramente projetos de inovação, desde a avaliação de viabilidade até o acompanhamento dos resultados. Colaborar com equipes multifuncionais para garantir o alinhamento dos investimentos com o retorno esperado.
  • Gestão de Budget:
  • Elaborar, acompanhar e revisar o orçamento das áreas de Vendas e Marketing, assegurando aderência às diretrizes corporativas.
  • Monitorar variações e propor ações corretivas para garantir o atingimento dos objetivos financeiros.
  • Business Partnering:
  • Atuar como consultor financeiro para os times de Vendas e Marketing, fornecendo insights e recomendações para maximizar resultados.
  • Participar de reuniões estratégicas, contribuindo com análises e cenários financeiros.
  • Análise de Performance:
  • Desenvolver relatórios gerenciais e dashboards para acompanhamento de KPIs, identificando oportunidades de melhoria.
  • Realizar análises de rentabilidade, margem e retorno sobre investimento (ROI) de campanhas e projetos.
  • Compliance e Governança:
  • Assegurar conformidade com políticas internas e externas, incluindo controles financeiros e auditorias.
  • Apoiar na implementação de melhores práticas e processos de controle.
  • Outros Processos Financeiros:
  • Apoiar processos de forecast, fechamento mensal, e revisões periódicas.
  • Participar de projetos de melhoria contínua e automação de processos financeiros
  • Diferenciais
  • Experiência em empresas de bens de consumo.
  • Vivência em projetos de inovação.
  • Conhecimento em sistemas ERP (SAP ou outros).

What can you expect from Mars?

  • Work with diverse and talented Associates, all guided by the Five Principles.
  • Join a purpose driven company, where we're striving to build the world we want tomorrow, today.
  • Best-in-class learning and development support from day one, including access to our in-house Mars University.
  • An industry competitive salary and benefits package, including company bonus.

title: Executive Assistant
description:
Company Overview
BotCity is building the future of automation with the Governance Platform for Python automations and AI Agents. We empower enterprises to innovate at scale by bringing governance, control, and observability to every automation project.

We recently raised a 12 million dollar Series A led by Four Rivers with participation from Y Combinator, SoftBank, and industry leaders such as Lew Cirne from New Relic, Rod Johnson from SpringSource, and Walter Kortschak from Summit Partners and Firestreak Ventures.

With more than one thousand customers in more than seventy countries and recognition by G2 as one of the world's top twenty five emerging platforms, BotCity is scaling fast. We are a global remote team across the US and LATAM and value impact, autonomy, and excellence.

Role Overview
The Executive Assistant will be instrumental in ensuring that key priorities for BotCity's growth are flawlessly executed, encompassing calendar mastery, diligent follow-through on deadlines, comprehensive travel coordination, and ensuring investor and board readiness. We are seeking an individual who operates at founder speed, brings calm structure to high complexity, writes clearly in both Portuguese and English, and possesses the flexibility to manage chaos and anticipate needs. This role will report to the CEO.

Responsibilities

  • Own the CEO calendar with prioritization, buffers, and preparation windows;
  • Support CEO on professional matters and as a personal assistant
  • Build daily and weekly planning rituals with simple and reliable structure
  • Prepare meeting briefs with context, goals, and suggested next steps
  • Capture decisions and actions and maintain a living tracker of follow ups
  • Support investor and board interactions with logistics and materials
  • Orchestrate domestic and international travel with one-page itineraries
  • Maintain Notion hubs and shared drives with clean and organized structure
  • Coordinate small events and side meetings when needed
  • Handle sensitive information with discretion and confidentiality
  • Manage and coordinate maintenance for Campinas and São Paulo offices.

Requisitos
Required Qualifications

  • Proven experience supporting founders or senior executives in fast-paced environments
  • Excellent written and spoken Portuguese and English
  • Mastery of Google Workspace, Notion, Slack, and scheduling tools
  • Strong organization and attention to detail with a double-check habit
  • Ability to anticipate needs and resolve conflicts
  • Comfort working across Brazil and US time zones
  • Experience working with MS Office/Excel, Google Suite, Notion, Slack.
  • Ability to travel as needed to support events, visit customers, and meet the team.
  • Portuguese - Fluent.
  • English - Fluent.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting investors and boards
  • Prior experience in an early-stage, high-growth, and fast-paced startup environment.
  • Experience planning travel and conferences
  • Ability to build simple processes that scale without bureaucracy
  • Experience in high-growth startups
  • Spanish - Advanced

title: Product Security Engineer
description:
Toradex is a global company strongly focused on engineering & technology. We're powered by a diverse & uniquely gifted workforce. We pursue the best people to propel our innovative vision of embedded computing and IoT. If you're interested in being a driving force at an agile technology company, engineering clever computing solutions & helping other companies bring their products to life, we should talk.

Overview


As a Product Security Engineer at Toradex, you'll be responsible for the implementation, validation, and maintenance of security features in Toradex's embedded software stack. That means hands-on, low-level work with bootloaders, Linux kernel security features, secure software updates and more.

We aim to make embedded software development easy and approachable, which means that our engineers have to go beyond just feature enablement. Your work will involve making the developer experience of working with low-level security features as smooth as it possibly can be. You'll work on systems used in critical industries like healthcare, industrial automation, and robotics.

Responsibilities

  • Security feature enablement: Bring up security features on new hardware. Every new product we release, we strive to have a uniform, straightforward experience for enabling basic hardware security features like secure boot, ARM TrustZone/OP-TEE, and hardware-backed encryption.
  • System-level hardening: Toradex maintains Torizon OS, a secure, production-ready embedded Linux OS. Making sure that security features fit into the whole stack, and that configurations are secure-by-default for the most common and supported workflows is a key part of the job. Understanding how everything fits together is a must.
  • Vulnerability management: Monitor upstream CVEs, assess their impact on Toradex products and their likely impact on Toradex customers' products. Apply patches and mitigations. Help draft security advisories and write VEX documents. Work on and maintain internal tooling for vulnerability management.
  • Security testing and automation: Automate test coverage of security features. Familiarity with LAVA or other hardware-in-the-loop embedded testing methodologies and frameworks is a strong plus.

Qualifications and Experience

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Cybersecurity, or equivalent experience
  • 3+ years of experience in embedded systems security or adjacent areas (e.g. Linux security engineering)
  • Hands-on experience with bootloaders (e.g., U-Boot), kernel security features, and embedded Linux distributions/build systems (Yocto/OpenEmbedded, buildroot, etc.)
  • Solid C/C++ coding and debugging skills
  • Experience with automating security checks in CI/CD pipelines
  • Knowledge of threat modeling/risk modeling methodologies and how they relate to regulatory and standards compliance is a plus
  • Knowledge of security evaluation and analysis tools like fuzzers and static analysis tools is a plus

What we offer

  • Agile, globally oriented and intercultural corporate culture.
  • Work on the latest hardware technology with early access to major SoC vendor
  • Enjoy a flat hierarchy where you may truly shape our hardware and software offerings
  • Count on a diverse team of experienced hardware and software engineers
  • Variety of knowledge sharing, training and self-development opportunities
  • The opportunity to play a key role in shaping your own work processes and your work environment.
  • Contemporary employment conditions, modern office space and a flexible working environment.
  • Opportunities for your personal development.
  • Meal allowance (flash card)
  • Health and dental care
  • Flexible working hours
  • Parking space
  • Anniversary day off

Disclaimer: This is not a temporary role. It is a long-term, full-time opportunity.

Toradex is a leader in embedded computing, serving innovative products to industrial, medical, automotive & IoT companies creating feature-rich & intelligent systems for demanding applications, e.g. supercars, self-driving tractors, patient monitoring systems – to name a few.

We provide effective & robust embedded computing solutions and strive for the best development experience in the industry with a focus on intelligent hardware design, innovative software solutions & free comprehensive support. Our relationship with our customers ensures that we all succeed and it allows us to participate in the realization of incredible new products. Our products are directly sold to more than 3'000 industrial customers in over 70 different countries worldwide.

title: 30/12/2024 - Presidente sanciona regra que limita aumento do salário mínimo; veja valor
description:
Presidente sanciona regra que limita aumento do salário mínimo; veja valor

O presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva sancionou a lei que estabelece um limite para o reajuste do salário mínimo, restringindo-o a até 2,5% acima da inflação entre 2025 e 2030. A medida integra o pacote de controle de despesas obrigatórias proposto pelo governo federal e aprovado pelo Congresso há cerca de dez dias.

Com a nova regra, o salário mínimo para 2025 deverá ser de R$ 1.518, um acréscimo de R$ 106 em relação ao valor atual de R$ 1.412. O número ainda será oficializado por decreto presidencial, a ser publicado nos próximos dias.

A medida busca alinhar o reajuste do salário mínimo ao novo arcabouço fiscal. Assim, os aumentos anuais serão limitados a uma faixa de 0,6% a 2,5% acima da inflação.

A política de correção do mínimo vigente desde 2023 será mantida, calculando-se o reajuste com base na soma da inflação acumulada pelo Índice Nacional de Preços ao Consumidor (INPC) até novembro e o crescimento do Produto Interno Bruto (PIB) de dois anos anteriores. No entanto, o teto de 2,5% acima da inflação agora restringe a parcela adicional vinculada ao PIB.

Salário mínimo
A aprovação da lei no final do ano legislativo deverá gerar uma economia de R$ 15,3 bilhões nos próximos cinco anos. De acordo com a Lei de Diretrizes Orçamentárias, cada real de aumento no salário mínimo eleva os gastos federais em cerca de R$ 392 milhões, sobretudo devido à Previdência Social e a benefícios vinculados ao piso, como o Benefício de Prestação Continuada (BPC).


Sob as regras anteriores, o salário mínimo de 2025 seria de aproximadamente R$ 1.528, considerando a inflação acumulada de 4,84% e o crescimento do PIB de 3,2% em 2023. No entanto, com o teto imposto pela nova legislação, o reajuste foi ajustado para R$ 1.518.

O pagamento do novo salário mínimo começará no final de janeiro ou início de fevereiro de 2025, referente ao trabalho realizado no primeiro mês do ano.

title: Comprador De Diretos / Hospital Care
description:
Em 2017, fundamos a Hospital Care com o objetivo claro de transformar o cenário da saúde suplementar no Brasil.

Nosso foco é estabelecer redes abrangentes de serviços de saúde, começando pela aquisição de hospitais privados de alta complexidade e expandindo de maneira orgânica. Essas redes, que chamamos de “Hubs”, conectam-se a diversos ativos, formando um ecossistema completo de serviços de saúde, desde laboratórios de exames, planos de saúde e centros médicos, até hospitais de alta complexidade.

Buscamos, através desta união tornar o sistema justo para todos os envolvidos, oferecendo aos pacientes tratamentos focados no seu bem estar, para as operadoras de saúde valores justos e sem desperdícios, aos colaboradores reconhecimento digno e aos investidores retornos sustentáveis, favorecendo toda a cadeia por meio de gestão otimizada e eficiente.

Atuamos para melhorar o acesso a saúde como um todo e nossas ações são orientadas para sermos a melhor rede de saúde privada do Brasil e para fortalecer o sistema de saúde brasileiro, promovendo o equilíbrio de interesses entre pacientes, médicos, fontes pagadoras, parceiros e acionistas.

Atualmente, contamos com 6 Hubs operacionais nas regiões Sul e Sudeste, compondo uma rede com 9 hospitais, mais de 1.479 leitos, 8.000 colaboradores e 13 mil médicos associados, além de duas operadoras de saúde.

  • Atender a alta demanda dos chamados e suas várias complexidades, consolidando, quando possível, as necessidades de compras de materiais e serviços das áreas usuárias;
  • Conhecer e executar a estratégia e a política de compras definidas para seu grupo de categorias;
  • Avaliar, desenvolver, cadastrar e manter informados os fornecedores sobre sua avaliação, atuando continuamente na identificação das oportunidades de geração de contratos e catálogos;
  • Avaliar e negociar contratos em geral (preço, prazos, SLA, reajuste, multas, vigência, escopo, etc) atuando com visão voltada ao Custo Total ou melhor condição, conforme perfil e valor da categoria;

  • Gerir e participar reuniões com clientes internos, externos e fornecedores e participar de treinamentos e integrações corporativas;

Responsabilidades:
  • Atuar no desenvolvimento, operação e evolução do SOC da Ekballo IT, com foco em ambientes críticos do setor elétrico;
  • Desenvolver, testar e operar playbooks de automação (SOAR) e processos robustos de Cyber Threat Intelligence (CTI) , alinhados aos padrões técnicos e regulatórios;
  • Assegurar a aderência total aos requisitos estabelecidos pelo ONS, ANEEL e às boas práticas aplicáveis ao segmento de transmissão de energia e subestações ;
  • Produzir documentação técnica rastreável, auditável e aderente aos processos regulatórios e operacionais;

Atividades Técnicas: Cyber Threat Intelligence (CTI):
  • Coletar, processar e enriquecer informações de ameaças (OSINT, FortiGuard, ISACs e outros feeds);
  • Correlacionar IOCs com eventos detectados no FortiSIEM, FortiEDR e ferramentas do ecossistema Fortinet;
  • Mapear TTPs com base nos frameworks MITRE ATT&CK, Diamond Model e Kill Chain ;
  • Produzir relatórios técnicos e executivos que suportem análises de riscos cibernéticos voltadas ao setor elétrico;
  • Alimentar o FortiSOAR com dados estruturados (STIX, TAXII, CSV, JSON) para automação de respostas;
  • Atuar em threat hunting , priorizando riscos e ameaças relacionadas a ambientes OT e sistemas críticos.
️ Automação e Orquestração (SOAR):
  • Projetar, desenvolver e manter playbooks no FortiSOAR , garantindo aderência técnica e regulatória;
  • Realizar integrações do FortiSOAR com FortiSIEM, FortiEDR, FortiMail, FortiWeb, FortiGate, além de sistemas de gestão como ServiceNow e GLPI;
  • Implementar automações que reduzam o tempo de resposta, otimizem o MTTR e fortaleçam a eficiência do SOC;
  • Realizar troubleshooting, ajustes e melhorias nas automações, utilizando APIs, Python, Bash ou PowerShell.
Compromissos Contratuais e Regulatórios:
  • A equipe alocada será composta por profissionais com experiência comprovada no setor elétrico , especialmente em projetos de transmissão de energia e subestações ;

  • Todos os profissionais serão previamente validados para atuação em ambientes regulados , garantindo aderência total às exigências do ONS, ANEEL e às boas práticas do setor ;
  • A Ekballo IT assegura rastreabilidade técnica e regulatória de toda a equipe e dos processos, garantindo uma operação completamente auditável e aderente aos padrões exigidos.
Requisitos Técnicos:
  • Experiência comprovada com desenvolvimento e operação de playbooks no FortiSOAR ;
  • Domínio das ferramentas Fortinet: FortiSOAR, FortiSIEM, FortiEDR, FortiAnalyzer, FortiGate, FortiMail, FortiWeb ;
  • Conhecimento sólido em Threat Intelligence, IOC Enrichment, STIX/TAXII, MITRE ATT&CK, YARA ;
  • Experiência anterior em ambientes de missão crítica, preferencialmente no setor elétrico (diferencial altamente valorizado);
  • Habilidade em automação de processos, integrações via API e desenvolvimento de scripts (Python, Bash, PowerShell);
  • Conhecimento dos requisitos normativos e regulatórios aplicáveis ao setor de transmissão de energia (diferencial).
Formação e Certificações:

  • Certificações Obrigatórias:
  • Fortinet NSE 4 – FortiGate Security
  • Fortinet NSE 5 – FortiSIEM / FortiSOAR
  • Certificações Desejáveis:
  • NSE 6 – FortiSOAR, FortiEDR, FortiAnalyzer
  • NSE 7 – Advanced Threat Protection
  • Outras certificações: CySA+, CTIA, GCTI, CEH, GCIA, GNFA, SANS

  • Escala: 5x2 , com atuação sob regime de plantão e sobreaviso , conforme cronograma técnico do projeto e exigências operacionais.

Job description

HOSPITAL CARE

Em 2017, fundamos a Hospital Care com o objetivo claro de transformar o cenário da saúde suplementar no Brasil.

Nosso foco é estabelecer redes abrangentes de serviços de saúde, começando pela aquisição de hospitais privados de alta complexidade e expandindo de maneira orgânica. Essas redes, que chamamos de “Hubs”, conectam-se a diversos ativos, formando um ecossistema completo de serviços de saúde, desde laboratórios de exames, planos de saúde e centros médicos, até hospitais de alta complexidade.

Buscamos, através desta união tornar o sistema justo para todos os envolvidos, oferecendo aos pacientes tratamentos focados no seu bem estar, para as operadoras de saúde valores justos e sem desperdícios, aos colaboradores reconhecimento digno e aos investidores retornos sustentáveis, favorecendo toda a cadeia por meio de gestão otimizada e eficiente.

Atuamos para melhorar o acesso a saúde como um todo e nossas ações são orientadas para sermos a melhor rede de saúde privada do Brasil e para fortalecer o sistema de saúde brasileiro, promovendo o equilíbrio de interesses entre pacientes, médicos, fontes pagadoras, parceiros e acionistas.

Atualmente, contamos com 5Hubsoperacionais nas regiões Sul eSudeste,compondo uma rede com9 hospitais, mais de 1.300 leitos, 7.500 colaboradores e 13 mil médicos associados, além de duas operadoras de saúde.

#vemserhospitalcare #vemparahospitalcare #vemserhc #jeitodeserhc #jeitodeserhospitalcare


Main responsibilities

Missão do cargo:

Responsável pela Coordenação do ambiente de Infraestrutura de T.I., abrangendo o ambiente on-premise e Cloud, corporativo e em todas localidades.

Garantir a escalabilidade e disponibilidade do ambiente de tecnologia para suportar as áreas de negócio, através de projetos e ações alinhadas a estratégia da companhia.

Sua missão é coordenar as ações, projetos e equipes multidisciplinares para elevar a confiabilidade dos serviços de T.I., através de melhoria contínua na infraestrutura essencial, assim como nos ambientes e soluções para sustentação e apoio ao negócio.

  • Irá coordenar a implantação de melhorias, mudanças, ações corretivas e requisições de serviços para elevar a confiabilidade na arquitetura dos ambientes de tecnologia.

  • Executar o gerenciamento de recursos humanos da equipe interna e/ou fornecedores da área de Infraestrutura de T.I. por meio de KPIs e SLAs.
  • Executar o planejamento e priorização das atividades da equipe de Infraestrutura, fazendo interface com as áreas de negócio.

  • Coordenar ações e garantir a atuação da equipe e fornecedores através das metodologias e frameworks como ITIL e COBIT, abrangendo escritório corporativo e demais localidades.
  • Será responsável pelo design, planejamento e execução de projetos relacionados aos ambientes de Servidores, Armazenamento, Backup, Virtualização, Cloud, Office 365, Active Direcoty, e demais ambientes correlacionados a infraestrutura de TI, garantindo a atualização tecnológica desses ambientes.

  • Garantir a qualidade das entregas e definir padrões de infraestrutura para a companhia.
  • Fomentar a implementação de modelos de trabalho que estejam em conformidade com as melhores práticas de mercado e os padrões estabelecidos pela governança corporativa de TI.
  • Promover o alinhamento às diretrizes corporativas de TI na resolução de incidentes e na execução de projetos voltados à melhoria contínua e à expansão dos serviços e infraestrutura aliadas as necessidades do negócio.

Diferenciais:

Somos um dos maiores empregadores do país, com 76 mil colaboradores e colaboradoras que trabalham diariamente pela missão de oferecer alimentos de qualidade a preços justos para o abastecimento de comerciantes, transformadores e consumidores finais.
Com infraestrutura moderna e eficiente, o Atacadão disponibiliza aos seus clientes uma variada gama de produtos, com cerca de 10 mil itens, nas categorias de laticínios, hortifrúti, bebidas, doces e biscoitos, higiene pessoal, limpeza, bazar, produtos da linha pet, automotivo, entre outros, além de serviços como padaria, açougue e frios e fatiados.
O Atacadão marca presença no ambiente digital por meio do seu e-commerce, com um próprio canal de vendas online mais direcionado a transformadores, comerciantes e empreendedores de pequenas, médias e grandes empresas , pela possibilidade de adquirir volumes maiores de itens, parcerias com aplicativos de entrega que atendem ao consumidor final, e também o Meu Atacadão, aplicativo que permite que os clientes encontrem ofertas diferenciadas enquanto fazem suas compras nas lojas físicas.
Tem como pilares de sustentabilidade o combate à fome e às desigualdades, a diversidade e inclusão e a proteção ao planeta & biodiversidade.

O Grupo Carrefour Brasil promove e incentiva a inclusão e a diversidade! Por isso, estimulamos a candidatura de mulheres, profissionais negros (as), LGBTI+ e de pessoas com deficiência.

A AVSI Brasil é uma organização da sociedade civil, sem fins lucrativos, criada em 2007, que atua com foco na melhoria das condições de vida de pessoas em situação de vulnerabilidade. Trabalha em parceria com atores da cooperação internacional, setor público e iniciativa privada. Vinculada à Fundação AVSI, ONG italiana atuante no Brasil desde os anos 1980, tem como missão promover o protagonismo das pessoas em seu desenvolvimento, de suas famílias e comunidades. title: Assessoria de Investimentos: Começo de carreira | Campinas
description:
Assessoria de Investimentos: Começo de carreira | Campinas

A XP Inc. é uma das maiores instituições financeiras independente do Brasil, dona das marcas XP, Rico, Clear, XP Educação, InfoMoney, entre outras. Com mais de 4,6 milhões de clientes ativos e um valor superior a R$ 1,1 trilhão de ativos sob custódia, há 24 anos vem transformando o mercado financeiro para melhorar a vida das pessoas.

Com uma cultura marcante guiada por quatro valores - Sonho Grande, Espírito Empreendedor, Foco no Cliente e Mente Aberta - a XP Inc. está sempre em busca dos melhores talentos que tem ambição de fazer o impossível.

Sobre a Oportunidade

Na XP Inc., acreditamos que nosso time é a chave para o sucesso. Procuramos profissionais em início de carreira, apaixonados pelo mercado financeiro, que compartilhem nossos valores: foco no cliente, espírito empreendedor, mente aberta e sonho grande.

Esta é uma oportunidade única para quem deseja iniciar sua trajetória como Assessor(a) de Investimentos nas marcas XP Investimentos e Rico. Valorizamos pessoas com perfil comercial, que se destacam no relacionamento interpessoal e são movidas pela busca de resultados consistentes.
Aqui, você terá todo o suporte para uma rápida integração e consolidação de seu novo escopo em assessoria, desenvolvendo e aprimorando habilidades de comunicação, aprofundamento nos produtos de financeiros e principalmente, uma imersão no dia a dia do mercado financeiro. Além disso, o programa conta com uma esteira robusta de carreira.

  • Perfil comercial e fortes habilidades de comunicação;
  • Alto nível de intensidade e disciplina para contato online com clientes;
  • Noções básicas de macroeconomia e atualidades;
  • Morar na cidade de Campinas, pois se trata de uma posição no modelo 100% presencial
  • Graduação superior cursando (a partir do 5º semestre) ou completa;
  • Se ainda estiver na faculdade, é necessário estar em um curso noturno;
  • Se identificar com a nossa cultura;

Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimento sobre produtos financeiros (RF, RV, fundos e outros);
  • CPA-20 ou CEA (Caso o candidato aprovado não tenha a certificação do CPA-20, fornecemos o curso de forma gratuita, em parceria com a Academia Rafael Toro)

Desafios e Impacto

  • Atuação no segmento de Assessoria de Investimentos, sendo responsável por aconselhar e auxiliar a gestão de patrimônio dos clientes;
  • Elaboração de portfólio de investimentos em linha com o perfil e objetivo dos clientes;
  • Análise de alocações externas, elaboração de estudos comparativos exclusivos e identificando oportunidades;
  • Acompanhamento de tendências de mercado, se mantendo sempre informado sobre atualidades do cenário econômico;
  • Disciplina para manter um alta frequência de contato com clientes de forma online e presencial.
    *Obs.: a contratação é CLT.

Triagem inicial : Análise do currículo para verificar a adequação às qualificações e requisitos da vaga.

Testes gerais : Avaliação do alinhamento cultural com o teste da Mindsight e teste de raciocínio lógico da Predictive Index.

Dinâmica e/ou entrevista com a equipe de Recrutamento : Dinâmica avaliando habilidades específicas necessárias para a função ou discussão sobre as expectativas em relação à vaga e aos objetivos profissionais.

Entrevista com a liderança : Uma conversa para discutir sua visão e como você pode contribuir para a equipe e a empresa.

  • Etapa de case: Onde você poderá demonstrar sua visão estratégica e tomada de decisão na construção de soluções para um cliente.

Entrevista com Head Comercial : Conversa para discutir sobre o seu perfil e características necessárias para contribuir com a operação

Entrevista focada em cultura : Exploração dos valores e princípios da empresa para garantir um bom encaixe cultural.

Oferta : Apresentação da proposta de trabalho, incluindo detalhes sobre remuneração e benefícios.

Saúde e bem-estar:

  • Plano de saúde sem coparticipação (inclusive, para dependentes)
  • iFood Benefícios (VA e VR flexível)
  • Licença parental: maternidade de 6 meses e paternidade de 20 dias.
  • Auxílio Creche

Vida Financeira

  • Assessoria de Investimentos
  • Cartão XP Visa Infinite sem anuidade
  • Crédito (consignado, home equity, CCB Imobiliário, etc.)

Modelo de Trabalho Presencial Flexível

O nosso modelo de trabalho varia de acordo com a função, podendo ser totalmente presencial para frentes de negócio e mais flexível para outras equipes.
Seguimos um modelo com mais frequência presencial, mas sempre guiado por flexibilidade e autonomia com a responsabilidade da nossa cultura empreendedora.

Aqui na XP Inc., valorizamos as interações pessoais e acreditamos no uso do escritório como uma ferramenta para potencializar nossas relações no trabalho.

AB InBev is the leading global brewer and one of the world’s top 5 consumer product companies. With over 500 beer brands, we’re number one or two in many of the world’s top beer markets, including North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Africa.

About ABI Growth Group

Created in 2022, the Growth Group unifies our business-to-business (B2B), direct-to-consumer (DTC), Sales & Distribution, and Marketing teams. By bringing together global tech and commercial functions, the Growth Group allows us to fully leverage data and drive digital transformation and organic growth for AB InBev around the world.

In addition to supporting well known global beer brands like Corona, Budweiser and Michelob Ultra, the Growth Group is home to a robust suite of digital products including our B2B digital commerce platform BEES, on-demand delivery services Ze Delivery and TaDa Delivery, and table top beer keg PerfectDraft.

We are an exceptional team, focused on understanding and supporting consumer and customer needs, harnessing new technology, and scaling growth opportunities.

What You Will Do

  • Partner with the managers, directors and technical leaders of our organization to elevate our architecture practices to the next level;
  • Collaborate and support the technical leaders in making technical decisions following our standards and guardrails/guidelines;
  • Help other teams to identify, prioritize, and resolve technical debts and bugs;
  • Foster adoption of best coding practices and patterns;
  • Write technical documentation (with charts, data points and diagrams) and present technical solutions to stakeholders in a clear and concise manner;
  • Help create the architecture principles and present to different stakeholders (e.g.: managers, technical leaders, directors, product managers);
  • Suggest, develop and implement new tools and technologies to solve cross-functional problems;
  • Communicate and elaborate ideas to both technical and non-technical individuals;
  • Identify possible improvements in our overall architecture, perform proof of concepts (POCs) and drive the adoption of new architectural concepts with different teams;
  • Assist in the career development of other developers by providing technical mentoring, pair programming and/or reviewing PRs;
  • Actively contribute to our Backend community by planning, executing and presenting in our Backend Guild sharing technical knowledge;
  • Facilitate communication and alignment of technical backlogs between squads.

What You Will Need

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or related field OR relevant time Software Engineering work experience;
  • Solid fundamentals in object-oriented design, data structures, algorithms, and problem-solving;
  • Expertise in at least one programming language and its main frameworks;
  • Experience in Systems Architectural styles (Monolith, Plugin, SOA, Microservices, Event-driven);
  • Knowledge of Architecture concepts (Software design, hexagonal architecture, onion, clean architecture);
  • Experience with APIs and capabilities;
  • Experience in leading the deployment of systems into production;
  • Familiarity with Cloud platforms and main providers;
  • Proficiency in SQL and NoSQL databases;
  • Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code (IAC) Technologies;
  • Experience in System Modeling (desirable experience in tactical DDD);
  • Familiarity with Monitoring Tools, Metrics, and Observability;
  • Experience with Agile Framework;
  • Understanding of DevOps culture, automation (CI/CD), and main tools;
  • Knowledge of Quality practices (stress tests, load, TDD, BDD);
  • Advanced level of english.

More about you

  • You´re passionate about software development and knows how to ensure its quality;
  • You´re motivated by building up world class solutions that impacts millions of users all over the world;
  • Experienced working in an environment which uses and stimulates DevOps culture;
  • You´re creative when solving problems and is continuously seeking improvements for processes and solutions;

Overview

Na Swarovski, onde a inovação se encontra com a inspiração, nosso pessoal de caixa são os nossos defensores, que prestam aos clientes um serviço extraordinário e uma experiência de marca inspiradora.

Responsável por auxiliar o gerente de boutique em todas as tarefas administrativas respeitando a abordagem e estratégia empresarial para atingir objetivos de desempenho definidos em termos de vendas, bem como os objetivos qualitativos, incluindo a qualidade do serviço e aparência da boutique de acordo com a estratégia e política da Swarovski.

Sobre o cargo

Você é defensor(a) da nossa marca. Nesta função, e juntamente com a equipa, irá:

  • Realizar as tarefas de Contabilidade, emissão de NF série 01e D1 e enviar os documentos fiscais ao escritório/ Pryor (NF´s , leitura X e leitura z) a fim de garantir o funcionamento dos procedimentos fiscais na boutique.
  • Realizar as tarefas de TI, solicitar manutenção de equipamento ou suporte do sistema quando necessário.
  • Realizar as tarefas de RH, envio de escala de folgas e folha de ponto ao escritório
  • Informar através do email e fax, a chegada de boletos bancários na boutique, e enviar posteriormente ao setor de contas as pagar.
  • Outras tarefas de rotina da área

Sobre você

Você é Um(a) Pessoa De Caixa Excecional, Que Nos Oferece

  • um excelente sentido de moda e uma verdadeira paixão pela nossa marca e os nossos produtos;
  • experiência/forte interesse nas marcas de moda/cosmética/estilo de vida de luxo;
  • uma personalidade fortemente motivada e focada na orientação do cliente;
  • dedicação e atitude orientada por objetivos;
  • vontade de desenvolver a sua carreira e crescer conosco

O que oferecemos

Você pode esperar uma série de benefícios, incluindo:

  • Descontos em produtos Swarovski
  • Programa de Assistência ao Funcionário
  • Licença para voluntario
  • Programas de aprendizagem e desenvolvimento

Sobre a Swarovski

A Swarovski produz produtos à base de cristal de qualidade e habilidade artística impecáveis que trazem alegria e celebram a individualidade. Fundada em 1895 na Áustria, a empresa desenha, fabrica e vende sofisticados cristais, pedras preciosas, diamantes e zircônias fabricadas e acessórios, bem como objetos de cristal e acessórios para a casa. A Swarovski Crystal Business tem alcance global com aproximadamente 2.400 lojas e 6.700 pontos de vendas em cerca de 140 países e emprega mais de 18.000 pessoas. Junto com suas empresas irmãs, a Swarovski Optik (dispositivos ópticos) e a Tyrolit (abrasivos), a Swarovski Crystal Business compõe o Swarovski Group. Uma relação saudável com as pessoas e com o planeta é parte da herança da Swarovski. Hoje, esse legado se fundamenta em medidas de sustentabilidade em toda a cadeia de valor, com ênfase na inovação circular, defendendo a diversidade, inclusão e autoexpressão, e no trabalho filantrópico da Swarovski Foundation, que apoia organizações de caridade que provocam um impacto ambiental e social positivo.

Swarovski é um empregador de igualdade de oportunidades. Oferemos à nossa equipe a coragem de celebrar a individualidade e o orgulho de criar um local de trabalho onde as pessoas se sintam envolvidas, respeitadas, valorizadas, conectadas e ouvidas. Um lugar onde qualquer pessoa se sinta parte da empresa. Todos os aspectos do emprego, incluindo a decisão de contratar, promover, disciplinar ou demitir, serão baseados no mérito, competência, desempenho e necessidades do negócio. Não discriminamos com base em raça, cor, religião, estado civil, idade, nacionalidade, deficiência física ou mental, condição médica, gravidez, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade ou expressão de gênero ou qualquer outro status protegido por lei nos países onde operamos.

description:
Job description

Em 2017, fundamos a Hospital Care com o objetivo claro de transformar o cenário da saúde suplementar no Brasil.

Nosso foco é estabelecer redes abrangentes de serviços de saúde, começando pela aquisição de hospitais privados de alta complexidade e expandindo de maneira orgânica. Essas redes, que chamamos de “Hubs”, conectam-se a diversos ativos, formando um ecossistema completo de serviços de saúde, desde laboratórios de exames, planos de saúde e centros médicos, até hospitais de alta complexidade.

title: Mechanical Engineer
description:
Overview

About Sierra Studio

When you apply to Sierra, you join an ecosystem. We specialize in connecting talented Brazilian professionals with exciting career opportunities in a highly-vetted small community of growing companies in the US. Applying to Sierra seamlessly integrates you into this ecosystem, granting automatic eligibility for all relevant opportunities we offer.

About our hiring partner

Our hiring partner is a consumer product development company. They help companies make new products & bring them to market, leading concepting, design, engineering, supply chain setup & ongoing operational oversight. They have teams in New York City, Hong Kong and beyond. They work with startups and established companies across many consumer categories; from connected hardware & electronics, to durable housewares and in-home goods, to soft-goods and packaging, and everything in between.

Who our hiring partner is looking for

They are looking for a motivated and hands-on Mechanical Engineer to join their team. This position will provide you with the opportunity to work on exciting development projects, helping to create and bring innovative products to life. You will apply your experience in mechanical design, CAD modeling, prototyping, while working alongside cross-functional teams to ensure the product meets all requirements from concept to production.

The Mechanical Engineer will be a member of our hiring partner's Brazil team - The position can be remote but will report to the Staff Engineer out of Campinas/SP. The Brazil team reports into the Head of Product based in HQ in NYC.

The Candidate

You have experience engineering new products and/or handling touchpoints throughout the concept to manufacturing journey. You've either built or supported bringing new products to the world, handling mechanical engineering design, research, testing, prototyping, and validation.

You have experience working with mass manufactured product and are familiar with a variety of materials. You're willing to research, learn, adapt and take initiative but not afraid of taking on challenges.

The Job

As Mechanical Engineer, you will:

  • Help to lead (and lead) development work from product definition through manufacturing.
  • Communicate progress to team members and project requirements for development and manufacturing.
  • Work closely with NYC and Asia teams to communicate and determine direction & solve development problems as they arise.
  • Collaborate with NY/Asia engineering teams to ensure the engineering designs meet client requirements and design intent.

Responsibilities

  • Assist and lead Mechanical Design: Support the design and development of product by creating 3D CAD models, producing engineering drawings, and necessary documentation. i.e. lead mechanical design engineering of a product from inception to manufacturing.
  • Prototyping & Testing: Build and test prototypes to validate designs, including hands-on assembly and working with external suppliers for prototype development.
  • Ensure efficient product development cycle with detailed prototyping, testing, and validation throughout the process.
  • Ensuring designs align with performance, material, and cost targets determined for each project.
  • Collaborate with Teams: Work closely with the engineering and design teams to ensure that products meet functional, material, and aesthetic goals. Communicate with marketing, operations, and manufacturing teams to align on project updates and requirements.
  • Support and Create Documentation: Assist with maintaining and updating CAD models and related product documentation (3D, 2D, etc.).
  • Product Testing: Help conduct off-tool and in-market sample testing, participate in troubleshooting and debugging design issues, and recommend improvements.
  • Learn from Experienced Engineers: Continue to build experience in various materials and different stages of product development while learning best practices from senior and staff engineers.
  • Support Supply Chain Efforts: Collaborate with the sourcing and supply chain teams to help gather information and support procurement of materials and components. Providing technical feedback and assets to support sourcing & supply chain teams, working closely with manufacturing engineers and suppliers.
  • Handle multiple projects and work independently.
  • Provide Engineering Support and Analysis to NY and HK engineering teams.
  • Build inhouse prototypes or scope external partners to prototype designs.

The Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in product development and mechanical engineering. Must have a portfolio with previously launched and manufactured products.
  • Proven experience within consumer electronics /household appliance industry and related industries focused on mechanical engineering
  • Engineering degree preferably Mechanical Engineering or a related field.
  • Highly proficient and deeply familiar with CAD tools (Solidworks, Onshape, or Creo) and prior experience with a variety of prototyping approaches
  • Hands-on experience with prototyping, 3D printing, or other fabrication tools is a plus.
  • Experience with a wide range of materials (plastics, metals, rubbers) and knowledge informing the material selection process.
  • Problem-solving mindset: Ability to approach challenges methodically applying analytical skills with proactive issue resolution- creating and guiding root cause analysis and DOE's.
  • Passion for product development: Interest in consumer product design, manufacturing, and mechanical systems.
  • Strong communication skills: Ability to work well with cross-functional teams and convey technical concepts clearly. Strong Presentation skills - especially conveying technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Excellent project management skills- with experience tracking numerous development projects simultaneously.
  • Ability to travel to Asia including Hong Kong, China, Vietnam, South Korea, and Taiwan.
  • High level proficiency in English language- written and spoken

Working Hours

While our work involves coordination predominantly with NY Team, there are meetings that are scheduled outside of traditional 9-6 working hours to accommodate the HK team. We trust all team members to manage their schedules and to take appropriate measures to take care of themselves and their wellbeing.

The Process

Please submit your resume and we will reach out if there is a potential fit.

Our hiring partner is constantly refining their hiring process to be as inclusive, transparent, and respectful of applicants' time as possible. As part of this process, you may be asked to complete a paid assessment based on the role.

Our hiring partner is an equal opportunity employer. They are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. They firmly believe that a diversity of experience, perspectives, and background lead to a better environment for their employees and to better results for their clients. They strongly encourage diverse candidates to apply.

description:
Embedded Linux Software Development Engineer

Toradex is a global company strongly focused on engineering & technology. We’re powered by a diverse & uniquely gifted workforce. We pursue the best people to propel our innovative vision of embedded computing and IoT. If you’re interested in being a driving force at an agile technology company, engineering clever computing solutions & helping other companies bring their products to life, we should talk.

Description

As an Embedded Linux Software Development Engineer BSP, you are part of the R&D team, making sure our Linux BSPs and related software offerings for our SoMs (System on Modules) are constantly developed, maintained, and quality improved. The work ranges from initial bring-up, to driver and kernel development, up to build-system, tooling and distro level development.

  • Develop and maintain Embedded Linux BSPs for Toradex' embedded computer modules
  • Eco-system: porting of third party software libraries, develop Software tools and utilities from scratch, Boot loader firmware
  • Mainline selected items
  • Suggest improvements related to products, software offerings, documentation, processes, etc. in order to allow continuous improvement
  • Work closely with other team members in an Agile development environment and participate in technical analysis and decisions
  • Communicate your work progress, coordinate with other development teams, and participate in R&D working groups

Skills

  • Expertise in Embedded Linux: Bootloader and Linux Kernel
  • Excellent C language knowledge and programming skills
  • Knowing OpenEmbedded/Yocto Project build system
  • Knowledge of industry standard interfaces and protocols such as I2C , SPI , UART , USB, Ethernet, PCI Express
  • C++/Python/Bash language knowledge and programming skills
  • Demonstrable Electronics knowledge and work experience: the ability to read and understand hardware schematics and datasheets; to use standard development aids such as oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, bus protocol analyzers, etc. when developing low-level software which interacts directly with machine registers
  • Familiar with communication peripherals (Bluetooth, Ethernet, Wi-Fi)
  • High-integrity, open, team player

Plus but NOT MANDATORY:

  • Experience with Real Time Operating systems
  • Knowledge of the ARM architecture

What do we offer

  • Agile, globally oriented and inter-cultural corporate culture.
  • Flexible working set up. Working remotely possible (within European time zone)
  • Work on the latest HW technology with early access to major SoC vendor
  • Enjoy a flat hierarchy where you may truly shape our HW and SW offerings
  • Count on a diverse team of experienced HW and SW engineers
  • Variety of knowledge sharing, training and self-development opportunities
  • The opportunity to play a key role in shaping your own work processes and your work environment.
  • Contemporary employment conditions, modern office space and a flexible working environment.
  • Opportunities for your personal development.
  • Meal allowance (flash card)
  • Health and dental care
  • Parking space
  • Anniversary day off

Todradex is a leader in embedded computing, serving innovative products to industrial, medical, automotive & IoT companies creating feature-rich & intelligent systems for demanding applications, e.g. supercars, self-driving tractors, patient monitoring systems – to name a few.

We provide effective & robust embedded computing solutions and strive for the best development experience in the industry with a focus on intelligent hardware design, innovative software solutions & free comprehensive support. Our relationship with our customers ensures that we all succeed and it allows us to participate in the realization of incredible new products. Our products are directly sold to more than 3'000 industrial customers in over 70 different countries worldwide.

description:
AgileEngine is an Inc. 5000 company that creates award-winning software for Fortune 500 brands and trailblazing startups across 17+ industries. We rank among the leaders in areas like application development and AI/ML, and our people-first culture has earned us multiple Best Place to Work awards.

WHY JOIN US
If you're looking for a place to grow, make an impact, and work with people who care, we'd love to meet you!

ABOUT THE ROLE
As a Product Manager , you’ll define strategy, lead teams, and deliver digital products that engage millions of users worldwide. Combining data-driven insights with market knowledge, you’ll shape product vision, mentor peers, and collaborate across functions. This role offers high impact, growth, and the chance to influence the future of digital media .

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Product Strategy – Develop and communicate a clear product strategy and vision for IGN’s digital platforms and products, aligning it with the company’s goals and objectives
  • Product Leadership – Lead multiple product teams and drive product strategy for a larger portfolio of products.
  • Team Leadership – Lead and mentor a team of product managers, providing guidance and support to help them achieve their goals and deliver high-quality products.
  • Product Roadmap – Define and maintain the product roadmap for multiple products, ensuring it aligns with business priorities, user needs, and market trends. Make data-driven decisions and prioritize features accordingly.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration – Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including engineering, design, editorial, and marketing, to ensure successful product development and delivery.
  • User Research – Conduct and analyze user research to gain a deep understanding of user needs, preferences, and pain points. Use this data to inform product decisions and improvements.
  • User Experience (UX) – Work with UX/UI designers to create user-friendly and visually appealing products. Ensure a seamless and engaging user experience across IGN’s digital platforms.
  • Data Analysis – Utilize data analytics and key performance indicators (KPIs) to monitor product performance, identify areas for improvement, and make data-driven decisions to optimize the product.
  • Product Development – Oversee the end-to-end product development process, from ideation to release. Coordinate with development teams to deliver high-quality products on schedule.
  • Project Management – Define and prioritize product features, enhancements, and requirements based on customer feedback, market research, and business impact. Collaborate with product managers to ensure that product feature prioritization aligns with the overall product strategy and roadmap.
  • Product Launch – Plan and execute successful product launches, including marketing strategies and user communication. Monitor product performance post-launch and iterate based on user feedback.
  • Stakeholder Communication – Keep stakeholders informed about the status of ongoing projects, milestones, and potential roadblocks. Maintain transparency and ensure alignment with business goals.
  • Market and Competitive Analysis – Stay informed about industry trends, emerging technologies, and the competitive landscape to identify opportunities and threats in the market.
  • User Feedback and Support – Engage with user feedback, reviews, and support channels to address user concerns, gather insights, and drive product improvements.

MUST HAVES
- 5-7 years working on technology-powered products as either a product manager or user researcher;
- Strong understanding of digital media platforms, technologies, and industry trends ;
- Proven ability of build intuitive content management systems that meet both internal and external customer needs;
- Experience in building subscription based products with a track record of driving growth;
- Led product development on complex features from 1st to Nth interaction;
- A history of deep and demonstrated understanding of the techniques and methods of modern product discovery and product delivery;
- Demonstrated ability to figure out solutions to hard problems with many constraints, using sound judgment to assess risks, and to lay out your argument in a well-structured, data-informed, written narrative;
- Proven ability to engage with engineers, designers, and company leaders in a constructive and collaborative relationship;
- Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience;
- Upper-Intermediate English level.

NICE TO HAVES
- Deep understanding of gaming trends;
- Strong background in app development and design.

PERKS AND BENEFITS
- Professional growth: Accelerate your professional journey with mentorship, TechTalks, and personalized growth roadmaps.
- Competitive compensation: We match your ever-growing skills, talent, and contributions with competitive USD-based compensation and budgets for education, fitness, and team activities.
- A selection of exciting projects: Join projects with modern solutions development and top-tier clients that include Fortune 500 enterprises and leading product brands.
- Flextime: Tailor your schedule for an optimal work-life balance, by having the options of working from home and going to the office – whatever makes you the happiest and most productive.

title: Chief Operating Officer (COO)
description:
Overview

InPlanet is a mission-driven, remote-first ClimateTech startup with hubs in Sao Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, New York and London. We are scaling Enhanced Rock Weathering (ERW) in tropical agriculture to remove carbon, regenerate soils, and transform how food is grown in the tropics. Our vision is to sequester gigatons of CO2 while regenerating tropical soils to create a liveable planet with nutritious food and healthy ecosystems for future generations. We are partnering with farmers, scientists, and industry leaders and are growing fast. Our culture blends people-first care and performance excellence. The Rocket represents our ambition and drive; the Heart symbolizes our focus on empathy, integrity, and collective impact.

We are proud of our globally diverse team and inclusive culture. Our teams span across continents, but our boots are firmly on the ground in Brazil where the real climate impact happens.

About The Role

Role: COO to lead go-to-market strategy for novel mineral-based carbon removal products across agricultural and mining sectors, and to evolve our operational backbone. You will oversee the entire value chain—from mineral inputs and field operations to the internal science engine and technology roadmap. This is a senior role where bold strategy meets operational precision to drive transformational scale.

Location & Travel: Hybrid, with travel in Brazil. Language skills: Portuguese, English (fluent). Start date: Ideally Q3/Q4 2025.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define and scale a novel carbon removal product from early traction to national impact in agriculture and mining; a 1-100 leadership role requiring bold strategy and relentless execution.
  • Lead the design and execution of a world-class ERW deployment operation across Brazil with scalability in mind.
  • Translate carbon and climate goals into clear operational strategies and regional delivery models.
  • Drive continuous improvement via operational KPIs, systemisation, and data-driven performance.
  • Collaborate with the Chief Impact Officer, Head of Operations, and VP of Science to align field strategy with scientific standards and operational goals.
  • Lead the integration of field deployment, scientific integrity, and operational scaling to ensure product-market fit.
  • Build cross-functional alignment to ensure the product offers agronomic value while meeting carbon certification requirements; orchestrate the 1-100 scale-up journey.
  • Oversee the sourcing, logistics, and deployment of rock powder from mine to farm; ensure compliance with carbon standards and farmer requirements.
  • Support legal to uphold integrity in carbon reporting and environmental impact.
  • Lead a large and growing team across Brazil and globally; collaborate with Carbon, Science, and Technology teams and strategic partners.

Team & Culture

  • Build a leadership culture that is entrepreneurial, fast, and accountable; turn high performers into high-impact owners.
  • Lead, mentor, and grow high-performing operations teams across Brazil and globally.
  • Champion a culture of accountability, collaboration, and impact-driven execution.
  • Empower regional managers and technical leads to deliver quality projects at scale.

You can be a Rock-Star if you have

Core Skills & Experience

  • 10+ years of senior leadership in operations, supply chain, or agribusiness in Brazil and in high-growth or startup contexts.
  • You have scaled something from messy beginnings to market success—ideally as a founder, GM, or CEO. You know what product-market fit looks like, and how to turn it into category leadership.
  • Proven experience leading multidisciplinary teams and building scalable systems from the ground up.
  • Strong communication and negotiation skills in Portuguese and English.

Key Qualities

  • Visionary but pragmatic—able to balance long-term strategy with daily urgency.
  • A confident, emotionally intelligent leader who knows when to listen, act, and delegate.
  • Comfortable navigating complexity, ambiguity, and rapid growth.
  • Hands-on, humble, and willing to “get your boots dirty” when needed.
  • Passion for sustainability, tropical agriculture, and climate innovation.

Bonus Points

  • Experience in impact-driven sectors such as climate, carbon markets, or regenerative agriculture is a big plus.
  • Deep knowledge and network of Brazilian agriculture, logistics, or mining.
  • Experience building strategic and commercial partnerships in Brazil, within agriculture.
  • Experience with building and scaling tech for agriculture.

Living Our Values

  • Trust: You believe in being kind and transparent in the workplace, fostering trust and collaboration.
  • Drive: You possess an innate drive to take action with a hands-on, can-do attitude, propelled by urgency.
  • Impact: You dream big and are committed to making a meaningful difference in the world, aligning with our mission to address climate change.
  • Compensation: Competitive compensation philosophy discussed in the first interview to manage expectations fairly.
  • Share options to make you feel like an owner.
  • Home Office Budget; Hybrid Remote around Sao Paulo.
  • Language Programme Monthly Allowance.
  • 40 days annual leave.
  • The opportunity to be autonomous and belong to a vision.
  • Bi-annual offsites in Brazil.
  • Laptop to fuel your productivity.

Application Process

Roughly 8 hours across 4-6 weeks from CV-screening.

  • Interview with VP of People
  • Interview with the Hiring Manager (required core skills and competencies)
  • 1-2 more 1:1 interviews with core leaders
  • Panel with 4+ team members (specific task, preparation needed)
  • Verbal reference check and psychometric profiling
  • Offer

How To Apply

  • Submit your CV in English, as this is the main language used at InPlanet (Portuguese accepted if justified).

Being an equal opportunity employer, InPlanet does not discriminate on grounds of gender, age, disability, religion, belief, sexual orientation, marital status, or race. We design our processes to be fair and equitable and believe in continuous learning.

title: VCP- Operador de Equipamentos
description:
Aeroporto de Viracopos (VCP)!
Responsibilities and assignments

Job Description
Venha trabalhar em uma das maiores empresas especializadas em assistência à aviação no país! ️
A dnata Brasil opera em 30 aeroportos, garantindo que todos os voos recebam o melhor atendimento com o máximo de agilidade; nossas equipes são reconhecidas pela dedicação, profissionalismo, ética, qualidade e expertise apresentados; somos 100% dedicados ao cumprimento de nossas funções.
Globalmente, a dnata foi fundada em 1959 em Dubai, possui mais de 46.000 funcionários divididos em 38 países nos 6 continentes, com atuação em 136 aeroportos e auxiliando mais de 347 clientes.
O Operador de Equipamentos ficará responsável por realizar a operação de atendimento de rampa (movimentação de equipamentos motorizados ou não, embarque e desembarque de passageiros cadeirantes, transporte de bagagens e cargas entre as áreas operacionais do aeroporto) em aeronaves com segurança, qualidade e pontualidade, garantindo eficiência no processo e colaborando para a construção da percepção do cliente quanto aos serviços prestados pela empresa no que tange ao transporte de bagagens, cargas e pontualidade dos voos.
Esta é uma vaga exclusiva para o Aeroporto de Viracopos (VCP)!
Responsibilities and assignments

  • Operar os equipamentos de rampa, realizando a movimentação segura de equipamentos rebocáveis no que tange a logística de preparação de box para atendimento dos voos com equipamentos necessários de acordo com a disponibilidade, levando-se em consideração o load fator, turnaroud da aeronave, distribuição de cargas e bagagens nos porões;
  • Disponibilizar os equipamentos de GPU, ACU e LPU sempre que a aeronave estiver com APU inoperante e/ou para a execução do projeto smart fuel;
  • Realizar o transporte de bagagem e cargas entre variadas áreas de cada aeroporto que estão embarcando, desembarcando ou em conexão;
  • Garantir a segurança de todos durante o atendimento operacional;
  • Garantir a transferência das bagagens de conexão imediata (HOT), para as outas aeronaves;
  • Recolher os equipamentos do box após o termino do atendimento.
Requirements And Qualifications
  • Carteira Nacional de Habilitação (CNH) tipo D/E.
  • Visão analítica e sistemática, para tomadas de decisões;
  • Disponibilidade de horário;
  • Conhecimento em processo de atendimento ao cliente;
Nos aspectos físicos exigem-se coordenação motora ampla e fina, destreza, articulação dos membros superiores e dos inferiores, postura variável para desenvolvimento de suas atividades, rotação e flexão do tronco e esforço físico, locomoção e deambulação para desenvolvimento das tarefas.
Nos aspectos sensoriais exigem-se acuidade visual para condução dos veículos (atividade regulamentada pelo CTB – código de trânsito brasileiro) e percepção auditiva para detecção de sinais sonoros emergenciais.
Nos aspectos neuropsíquicos exigem-se atenção, concentração, habilidade organizacional, criatividade, interpretação de dados e iniciativa para solução de situações causais.
Additional information

Líder mundial em fornecer serviços aéreos!

A dnata Brasil opera em 30 aeroportos, atendendo as principais companhias aéreas nacionais e internacionais que operam no país, sempre 100% dedicados em cumprir nossas funções com ética, qualidade, expertise e excelência.

Na Odontoclinic, somos movidos por pessoas e por sorrisos.

title: Upstream Bioprocess Scale-up Engineer Specialist
description:
Overview

Braskem, a global leader in the production of bio-based materials, is committed to reducing the carbon intensity of its products through development of technology utilizing bio-based feedstocks. In addition to its existing biotechnology research center in Campinas, Brazil, Braskem has recently opened a new renewable research and development facility in Lexington, MA. These two state-of-the-art facilities bring together scientists and engineers from a variety of disciplines to ideate and develop novel technologies for the production of bio-based chemicals and materials.

Role Description

Braskem Innovation and Technology is seeking an exceptional upstream bioprocess engineer for to scale-up of emerging technologies in the area of bio-based chemicals via fermentation processes. The candidate will work closely with the fermentation development team and have primary responsibility for commercial process design, ensuring technical risks are addressed and mitigated in the scale-up from lab to pilot/demo phases. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in fermentation scale-up with experience in implementation of new technology at industrial scale and comfort working closely with innovative teams from research and development.

Key Responsibilities

  • Synthesize the upstream conceptual process design for fermentation-based technologies emerging from discovery teams in lab. This includes all steps from feed preparation, seed train, and fermentation sections of the flowsheet.
  • Work closely with the fermentation development team to guide experimental work with a view toward the commercial process design, and ensure relevant technical targets are set based on commercial process economics.
  • Guide the planning of the pilot plant testing program according to the conceptualized commercial design to ensure the key risks are mapped and mitigate as the technology progresses through scale-up.
  • Build strong relationships while working closely with the firms operating or constructing the pilot plant fermentation units.
  • Generate the technology transfer package in collaboration with the fermentation development team for upstream section of the bioprocess. Serve as the fermentation process expert during pilot and demo testing, being present onsite for extended campaigns.
  • Support process safety reviews for emerging technologies.
  • Own responsibility as the expert on the process technology and key deliverables of the Process Design Package PDP that will be the basis for commercial design and engineering or toll manufacturing.

Additional Responsibilities and Activities

  • Identify and evaluate innovative and disruptive technologies through interaction with technology licensors, participation in events associated with bio-based chemical technologies, and review of international publications.
  • Carry out techno-economic assessments, actively participating in the preparation and/or technical review of mass and energy balances, PFDs, Capex and Opex estimates, among others.
  • Work with different teams within Braskem (eg process engineering, biotech and catalysis, sustainability, innovation, intellectual property, etc.) to guarantee the successful development of projects.
  • Collaborate with universities, start-ups and technology hubs seeking new technologies that may be of interest to Braskem.

Requirements

  • B S in Chemical Engineering or relevant field (PhD is a plus) with a strong background in new technology development
  • 10+ years (including graduate research) experience in bioprocess engineering
  • Demonstrated experience in process development and scale-up for fermentation technology with implementation of new technology at industrial scale
  • Demonstrated expertise using process simulation software (eg SuperPro or Aspen Plus)
  • Experience in pilot plant and/or demo plant operations
  • Experience with microbial, aseptic aerobic fermentation in stainless steel SIP fermenters
  • Strong technical judgement to assess project decisions and timetables
  • Ability and seniority to ensure good interpersonal relationships and people management, to work on projects with internal and external interfaces
  • Have a working knowledge of intellectual property
  • English and Portuguese fluency is required

Location: Hybrid mode with a home site of Campinas, Brazil to ensure a close working relationship with research teams at the Braskem Tech Centers.

Job details

  • Seniority level: Mid-Senior level
  • Employment type: Full-time
  • Job function: Engineering and Information Technology
  • Industries: Plastics Manufacturing

Este profissional atuará na criação de ferramentas de cálculo, templates para especificação de equipamentos e na comunicação entre os diversos departamentos da empresa para entender e atender suas necessidades, sempre buscando o incremento de produtividade e melhoria da assertividade da engenharia desenvolvida pela GEA.

Responsibilities

  • Definir e documentar padrões e procedimentos de trabalho para as diversas disciplinas de engenharia.

  • Desenvolver templates padronizados para a especificação de equipamentos (instrumentos, válvulas, bombas, trocadores de calor, filtros, purgadores, etc.).
  • Colaborar com os diversos departamentos da empresa para entender suas necessidades e desenvolver soluções de engenharia customizadas.
  • Participar da implementação e do treinamento de novas ferramentas e procedimentos de engenharia.

  • Manter-se atualizado com as melhores práticas e as novas tecnologias de engenharia, incluindo inteligência artificial.
  • Contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos processos do PMO de Engenharia.
  • Contribuir diretamente para o aumento da produtividade e da assertividade dos engenheiros, através da criação e implementação de padrões, procedimentos e ferramentas de engenharia.
  • Suportar a melhoria contínua dos processos de engenharia, resultando em maior eficiência e redução de custos nos projetos da GEA.
  • Otimizar o tempo de execução das tarefas de engenharia, permitindo que os engenheiros se concentrem em atividades de maior valor agregado.
  • Promover a inovação ao buscar e implementar tecnologias modernas, como a Inteligência Artificial, para otimizar os processos de engenharia.
  • Estar aberto a mudanças e atuar como promotor de novas práticas e tecnologias que agreguem valor aos diversos departamentos da GEA.
  • Participar ativamente na identificação de oportunidades de melhoria e na implementação de soluções inovadoras para os desafios de engenharia.
  • Interno: Gestão da divisão e do país, departamentos de vendas, tecnologia global, produção, qualidade, etc.
  • Externo: Fornecedores de software e ferramentas de engenharia, consultores.
  • Possuir poder de decisão dentro de sua área de atuação, no que se refere à definição de padrões, procedimentos e ferramentas de engenharia.
  • Propôr e implementar melhorias nos processos de engenharia, buscando sempre a otimização e a padronização das atividades.
  • Colaborar com os diversos departamentos da empresa para entender suas necessidades e desenvolver soluções de engenharia customizadas, mas as decisões finais sobre a implementação de soluções complexas são tomadas em conjunto com a gestão do PMO.

  • Experiência comprovada em projetos de engenharia, preferencialmente em indústrias de alimentos, bebidas, farmacêutica ou química.

title: Senior Systems Analyst (IBM Power Systems)
description:
Role and Responsibilities

  • Interact with Global Managed Services (GMS) customers daily in support of the environments managed by GMS – hosted or remote by
    • Resolving environment-related problems reported by GMS customers through CSS as assigned
    • Completing service requests submitted by GMS customers, including managing customer user IDs, remote print writers and/or queues, and similar requests
    • Submitting service requests for data center services needed by GMS customers
    • Acting as a liaison between GMS customer and Netcracker IT Group to facilitate the completion of requests
    • Researching system and database journals to retrieve auditing information in support of internal and customer data investigations
    • Troubleshooting problems with TCP/IP-based interfaces using IBM and third-party network tracing tools
  • Configure and monitor systems to ensure
    • peak and problem-free operation
    • compliance with security standards
  • Configure and support
    • Software-based replication, particularly using Vision Solutions MIMIX HA1, as it relates to both HA and DR implementations.
    • System monitoring, particularly using Help Systems Halcyon, especially as it relates to interface/job monitoring
    • Tape management systems, particularly using IBM’s BRMS.
    • System compliance and audit functions, particularly using Enforcive Enterprise Security, especially as it relates to PCI compliance
    • Automation functions, particularly using Help Systems Robot SCHEDULE and REPLAY, or IBM’s Advanced Job Scheduler
    • Browser-based GUI interface, particularly using Rocket Software’s LegaSuite application over Netcracker’s ICOMS solution.
    • Digital certificates using IBM Digital Certificate Manager
    • End user access to system tools using IBM i Navigator
  • Maintain application environments by
    • Reviewing patches and release updates and constructing a plan to apply them to Netcracker and third party applications
    • Creating custom programming using CL, RPG, or other available languages in support of production processing
    • Performing regular maintenance tasks on time to ensure PCI compliance
  • Regularly review
    • Security bulletins issued by US-CERT, IBM, and other vendors, especially related to PCI compliance. Resolve any vulnerabilities on time
    • System performance statistics, forecasted growth data, and project system resource utilization, making recommendations for hardware and/or software upgrades to meet demand.
    • Disaster Recovery Plans and participate in annual Disaster Recovery Exercises, focusing on validating business continuity plans for GMS customers. Update the DR plans to reflect current configurations, environments, and processes.
  • Manage the underlying systems supporting the ICOMS solution by
    • Upgrading firmware, and HMC release levels in accordance with IBM compatibility matrices and recommendations
    • Allocating system resources for production and test partitions
    • Preparing system plans for partitions on Power Systems servers
    • Installing hardware components required by the solution
    • Reading the PAL and SAL in System Service Tools (SST) and Service logs in the HMC to assist hardware maintenance providers with troubleshooting, and resolving hardware problems.
  • Will be asked to perform similar duties for internal (development/test) systems as well.
  • May be asked to perform consulting services for customers outside of GMS

Required Experience

  • Minimum of 5 years experience (preferably more) administering IBM i running on Power Systems servers.
    • Must be familiar with all aspects of system administration, including upgrades from previous releases, backup and recovery, storage management, using journaling, understands the differences between various types of ASPs and their uses, and has strong HMC skills.
  • IBM Certified System Administrator - IBM i 7.x (highly preferred)
  • At least one major system hardware upgrade (for example POWER6 to POWER7)
  • At least two major operating system upgrades (for example, IBM i 5.4 or 6.1 to 7.1)
  • At least two full system restores (as if from a site-down crash)
  • Experience in managing partitioned systems
  • Strong experience in using database journaling, especially remote journaling
  • Strong experience with utilizing Performance tools such as IBM Job Watcher/Pex and MPG Performance Navigator
  • Understands the differences between independent ASPs, *SYSBAS, and traditional ASPs
  • Understands the functional differences between logical replication and clustering
  • Understands IBM i security administration, compliance, and access control
  • Extensive knowledge of the HMC
  • Some experience managing IBM i with SAN-attached storage
  • Keeps up with IBM hardware announcements, and has an awareness of IBM technical directions for their product lines
  • Keeps up with Technology Refreshes, and has an awareness of new features and functions
  • Is very familiar with the IBM Memo to Users for V7R1 as of April 2012, and any subsequent Technical Releases (TRs)
  • Ability to train operations monitoring staff on how to respond to alerts, ensure “switch readiness” on HA/DR systems, and perform less complex maintenance window activities
  • Must be able to provide 24x7 on-call support coverage - on a rotational basis with other team members. (on occasion)

Other Highly Desired Skills

  • Experience installing software upgrades and updates to third party and in-house developed applications
  • Very familiar with the use of MIMIX software for logical replication of database information to redundant systems for high availability and disaster recovery deployments
  • Very familiar with the configuration and management of ODBC / JDBC / TCP socket communications on IBM i systems communicating with other applications running on Unix / Linux & or Windows systems
  • Very familiar with current PCI-DSS standards and how to ensure PCI compliance on IBM i operating system and database containing PCI sensitive data
  • Experience managing medium projects, lasting a few weeks, involving two or more teams.
  • Fluent English Speaker and availability to work from office on Hybrid mode
  • Must be able to work on Shifts mode

Education

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Engineering or related field

About AB InBev Growth Group

Created in 2022, the Growth Group unifies our business-to-business (B2B), direct-to-consumer (DTC), Sales & Distribution, and Marketing teams. By bringing together global tech and commercial functions, the Growth Group allows us to fully leverage data and drive digital transformation and organic growth for AB InBev around the world.

The Product Manager for BEES Deliver will play a pivotal role in driving the product evolution and development of our logistics digital transformation solution. This role involves leading cross-functional teams to enhance product features, optimize connectivity with the BEES ecosystem, and ensure a seamless delivery experience for our global customers. The Product Manager will be responsible for structuring the core journey of BEES Deliver to become a global product and expand its reach with minimal customizations.
